data.one_liner: Official Flutter plugin for Customer.io messaging platform
data.what_it_does: Provides a Flutter wrapper around the Customer.io SDK, enabling push notifications, live activities, deep linking and in-app messaging. It handles native initialization, token registration and routing of URLs to the Flutter app.
use_when: You need to send automated messages or in-app notifications via Customer.io
You want to use Customer.io live activities on iOS
You need deep link handling integrated with Customer.io events
avoid_when: You are not using Customer.io as your messaging backend
You prefer a different push notification service like Firebase or OneSignal
strengths: Supports iOS live activities and deep linking
Handles native token registration and routing automatically
Compatible with Flutter 3.44+ and uses Kotlin for Android
weaknesses: Requires Flutter 3.44+ and native setup steps
Only works with Customer.io, no alternative messaging services
data.setup_notes: Add the plugin to pubspec, run pod install or Gradle sync, add NSSupportsLiveActivities to Info.plist, configure Android gradle.properties for live activities, initialize CustomerIOConfig in Dart, and register the plugin in main.dart. No build_runner needed.
